scopes.title: Selected CMASS release identities, formats and covariance requirements
scopes.checked_claim: Original Hector Gil-Marin notes dated13Feb2020 and author pages dated17Feb2020 identify pre-recon P data, B0 data, post-recon BAO and separate bestfit products. Current exact linked archives and ten CMASS members are hash-bound; P comment headers and notes locate seven-column P/B formats, physical units and already-subtracted shot noise; notes identify already-squared six-column cap mask functions and weighted density roles. June2016 README distinguishes cap-averaged power measurements, bestfit curves, power-only covariance and rectangular window matrices. Original notes require paired2048 MD-Patchy statistics for a chosen P/B data vector with full auto/cross covariance; source reporting alone is accepted.

limitations: Released pre-reconstruction cap P/B estimates and separate2016a/b power products are source-owned reductions. They are not raw galaxy observations, an independent amplitude measurement, a qualified likelihood, or an executable native model.

2016 archive contains weighted NGC+SGC power estimates, diagonal errors, bestfit curves, power-only covariance and window matrices. Its covariance cannot replace the P0/P2/B0 joint auto/cross covariance. Arrays/dimensions/interleaving were not numerically validated.

Current release pre-reconstruction P headers report cap data effective redshifts0.589341/0.590627 and randoms0.547267/0.547683, distinct from analysis zeff0.57. Definitions are preserved; no automatic replacement or proof of contradiction. Historical estimator/byte equality to the2017 paper is unestablished.

Exact selected bin/triangle order and paired mock realization IDs are required for all auto/cross covariance blocks. No mocks were downloaded/read, no covariance constructed or inverted, no Hartlap likelihood correction executed. Page11 line278 labels B mocks post-recon while notes/data say pre-recon; pairing/reconstruction is unresolved.

Masks supply already-squared W_l^2, not a complete bispectrum survey window. Notes offer only a partial individual-power approximation with squeezed-triangle limitations. Density units and intrinsic headerless B/mask self-description remain unlocated; dimensional reader deductions are separate.

Formal notes are incomplete on RSD/AP/selection/LOS physics. Printed Eq2 Fourier normalization/measure, Eq5 triangle count normalization, p3 linear-bin units, Eq9 likelihood label, Eq14 internal operator and Table1 Patchy sigma8=8288 issues remain literal. No silent repair or author-code equivalence is accepted.

Source claims of independent sky-cap/sample likelihoods and arbitrary high-k validity are reported assertions, not verified independence or scientific qualification. Same galaxy, random, fiducial, mask and mock ancestry links power-only RSD, P+B RSD and post-reconstruction BAO; cross-analysis covariance remains unknown. Linear/log P are alternative reductions, not independent samples.

Source-specific redistribution licences are unresolved. Citation requests, as-is disclaimers, successful public GETs and a failed connector materialization establish no licence or licence denial. Only metadata, links and original short review notes may be public; raw sources stay local.

Asset-only targeted review; navigation association to existing1606.00439v2 does not review that paper anew. Zero Luna/full-paper reads, promotions, experiments, fits, compiler jobs, native execution or numerical/scientific acceptance.
